$description: Canonical BeeUI design-token source. This document conforms to the DTCG 2025.10 Format and Color modules; BeeUI runtime metadata lives under $extensions.

lifecyclePolicy.minimumCompatibilityWindow: At least one subsequent pre-1.0 minor release before a deprecated public token is removed.
lifecyclePolicy.governedScope: Public foundation scale tokens and semantic color tokens.

overlay-enter.description: Overlay surface appearing (dialog, alert dialog, popover, dropdown menu, select, toast). Opacity paired with a small scale-up; springs make the entrance feel spatially anchored.

overlay-exit.description: Overlay surface dismissing. Dismissal should feel immediate, so exit uses fast timing rather than a spring that could overshoot.

disclosure.description: Disclosure surface expanding or collapsing (accordion, collapsible). Size reveal paired with opacity; timing avoids spring overshoot on height.

descriptions.compact: Dense desktop/admin surfaces (dashboards, data tables, settings lists) where users benefit from higher information density and precise pointer input. Native interactive hit targets are never reduced below the accepted minimum.
descriptions.comfortable: Default application density. Preserves the BeeUI v2 visual baseline exactly.
descriptions.spacious: Roomier touch-oriented surfaces and wide desktop layouts where extra breathing room improves scanability.

contrastContract.description: Deterministic, machine-tested semantic contrast relationships that mirror actual component surface/state adjacency. Canvas tokens and documented exceptions are intentionally excluded so the matrix never claims a relationship BeeUI does not certify. All runtime themes (built-in brand themes and accessibility high-contrast themes) must satisfy every entry below; accessibilityOnlyPairs and accessibilityMinTextRatio apply only to accessibilityRuntimeThemeNames.

textPairs.usage: Primary body/heading text on every realistic canvas.
Secondary/muted text on the page, muted-card, and raised-card canvases.

filledActionPairs.usage: Primary filled action label across default/hover/pressed (#65).
Secondary filled action label across default/hover/pressed (#65).
Destructive filled action label across default/hover/pressed (#65).

feedbackFillPairs.usage: Success badge/banner fill with its foreground text.
Warning badge/banner fill with its foreground text.
Info badge/banner fill with its foreground text.

controlBoundaryPairs.usage: Text input boundary against the input surface (#66).

focusRingPairs.usage: Focus ring against every realistic adjacent surface it can appear on (#66, expanded by #77 to include surface-raised).

invalidBoundaryPairs.usage: Invalid/destructive control boundary against realistic surfaces (#66).

accessibilityOnlyPairs.usage: Checkbox/Radio unchecked boundary. Certified only for accessibilityRuntimeThemeNames; default light/dark/violet-light/violet-dark are not yet certified for this relationship (tracked separately, out of #77 scope).

exceptions.reason: Low-emphasis role; intentionally below the 4.5:1 body-text threshold and not approved for normal body copy.
Disabled surface fill; inactive-component contrast exemption. Disabled state is also signalled by reduced opacity, not color alone.
Disabled text/icon foreground; same inactive-component exemption as disabled.
Subtle structural divider; decorative and never the sole means of conveying a required boundary or state.

Used as the Checkbox/Radio unchecked boundary against input. Default light/dark/violet-light/violet-dark do not yet certify 3:1 for this pair; accessibilityOnlyPairs certifies it for the high-contrast runtime themes. Fixing the default themes is tracked separately and out of #77 scope.
Scrim overlay; decorative background dimming, not content.

chartColorDescriptions.neutral: Flat, unchanged, or baseline trend/series value.
chartColorDescriptions.highlight: Emphasis for a selected, reference, or compared data point/series.
chartColorDescriptions.axis: Chart axis line and tick/label color.

chartContrastContract.description: Deterministic, machine-tested chart-token contrast relationships (#78), the data-viz counterpart to com.beeui.contrastContract. Scoped to the chart semantic-color domain: each entry's indicator draws from com.beeui.chartColorDescriptions (never a semantic color token), and its adjacent backgrounds draw from the ordinary semantic-color canvas tokens a chart actually renders on. All runtime themes (built-in brand themes and accessibility high-contrast themes alike) must satisfy every required pair below.

requiredPairs.usage: Categorical series 1 legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Categorical series 2 legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Categorical series 3 legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Categorical series 4 legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Positive financial/trend delta legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Negative financial/trend delta legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Flat/baseline series legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Highlighted/selected series or data-point legibility on every realistic chart canvas.
Axis line and tick-label legibility on every realistic chart canvas.

exceptions.reason: Subordinate gridline; decorative structural aid, never the sole means of conveying required chart information (mirrors the colors.border decorative exception).

spacing.$description: Base spacing values exposed to TypeScript consumers.

fontFamily.$description: Platform font-family intent. "sans" resolves to the platform default UI font; "mono" is a system-monospace fallback stack. BeeUI never bundles or force-loads a proprietary font.

mono.$description: System-monospace fallback stack for reference codes, IDs, and technical values. No proprietary font is bundled; the consuming app may map these families to a licensed monospace font it loads itself.

lineHeight.$description: Line heights paired with semantic typography sizes.

letterSpacing.$description: Canonical tracking values in px. CSS em output is derived using BeeUI's 16px CSS reference.

controlSize.$description: Control geometry and minimum touch target.

iconSize.$description: Icon geometry independent of icon library.

elevation.$description: Cross-platform layering intent expressed as DTCG shadows; BeeUI extensions preserve platform serialization metadata.

motionDuration.$description: Motion durations; tokens do not make animation mandatory.

motionEasing.$description: Supported easing curves in DTCG cubic Bézier form.

layer.$description: Semantic stacking-order (z-order) contract for reusable BeeUI surfaces. Distinct from `elevation`, which encodes shadow depth. Values use intentional gaps so applications can insert local sublayers without collision.

base.$description: Default in-flow content plane; anchored overlays and toasts render above this.

overlay.$description: Anchored transient surfaces (dropdown menu, popover, select listbox) and the overlay host outlet; renders above base content.

com.beeui.role: Anchored transient overlay surfaces and the overlay host outlet.

toast.$description: Transient notification viewport; renders above base content and anchored overlays.

breakpoint.$description: Minimum stable responsive breakpoints (min-width thresholds). Web-only build-time constants consumed by Tailwind/Uniwind responsive variants; BeeUI does not run a second media-query engine. Viewports below the smallest threshold are the implicit compact base.

com.beeui.intent: Tablet portrait and larger: multi-pane layouts and wider page gutters become available.
Desktop-wide: max-width content containers stop growing and center in the viewport.

pageGutter.$description: Semantic horizontal page-edge padding. Cross-platform dimension usable on web (Tailwind spacing utility) and React Native. Applied inside safe-area insets, never replacing them.

com.beeui.intent: Dense list/feed screens and narrow viewports.

rowHeight.$description: List/table row minimum height by application density intent (#74). "comfortable" preserves the pre-#74 ListItem height exactly. Flagged nativeHitTargetSensitive so no mode may fall below controlSize.touchTarget.

rowGap.$description: Internal gap between a list row's leading/content/trailing regions (ListItem) by application density intent (#74). "comfortable" preserves the pre-#74 value exactly.

formGap.$description: Vertical gap between a form field/group's label, control, and helper text (Field, FormGroup) by application density intent (#74). "comfortable" preserves the pre-#74 value exactly.

white.$description: Pure white anchor shared by light surfaces and on-color foregrounds.

on-emphasis.$description: Foreground for destructive fills on dark appearances.

success.$description: Shared success fill for dark appearances.

info.$description: Shared informational fill for dark appearances.
